name: @recueil/plugin-dedup-core
description: Finds duplicate items: an exact match on DOI, PMID, PMCID, arXiv id or ISBN, and a fuzzy match on title, year and first author that is only ever proposed for review.

hooks.title: Same identifier
hooks.description: Two items carrying the same normalised DOI, PMID, PMCID, arXiv id or ISBN are the same work.

hooks.title: Same title, year and first author
hooks.description: Near-identical titles from the same year (±1) by the same first author; proposed for review, never merged automatically.
